summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload on npm install
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, indirected string tables) and downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the platform-specific `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it 0o755, and executes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB opaque Bun-cjs bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, custom string-array decoder, hex-mangled identifiers) that ships in the tarball and is unrelated to the package's advertised React/browser chatbot API surface. The setup script also branches on `/etc/os-release` to detect Alpine/musl, indicating platform-specific dispatch of the payload. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook, so every installer executes the fetched Bun binary against the opaque bundled payload. The alternate-runtime choice (Bun rather than Node) bypasses Node-focused static analyzers and hides the payload's behavior behind a runtime that most supply-chain scanners do not evaluate.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
